F. G. REG
No 286
Date 18/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

16th April 1916

Sir,
The police officer in charge of the 5th district
in Chapel absconded on 14th instant. A thousand
dollars reward has been offered for his arrest. It
is reported that this man, who is a revolutionary,
ran away because his superiors had found out his
connection with that party.
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels have
sent fifty men to Yangchow to arrange for the
declaration of independence by that place.
Chen Chi May 陳其美 and Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕鈇生
are in Shanghai and are leaders of the rebels here.
It is reported that General Yang fears that the
troops in Pootung and Chapel are not loyal.
It is reported that General Lui, in consequence
of information that the gunners of the Woosung forts
had been bought over by the rebels, has detailed some
trusted men to look after them.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entries entered Apl. 16.
pages.zh:
F. G. REG
第 286 号
日期 1916年4月18日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年4月16日

先生：

负责第五区（Chapel）的警官于本月14日潜逃。已悬赏一千元缉拿此人。据报，此人为革命党人，因其上级发现其与该党派有联系而畏罪潜逃。

据报，上海反叛者已派遣五十人前往扬州，以安排该地宣布独立事宜。

陈其美与钮鈇生现居上海，系此地反叛者之领袖。

据报，杨将军担心驻守浦东及 Chapel 的部队不忠。

据报，刘将军因获悉吴淞炮台的炮手已被反叛者收买，故特派数名亲信人员加以监视。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

条目录入于4月16日。
